messages.subject: Git setup for Shiny
parts:
I'm new to Git and would like some advice on which folder to make the "repository" when working with Shiny. Choices seem to be the .app folder, the one above that, which would include www, or the one above that. Or maybe I'm totally lost.

Also, when your app has data files, do you keep the data files outside this structure or have Git ignore them?

Tom

messages.author: 5ab11db47365dff1
messages.subject: Re: Git setup for Shiny
parts:
No reason not to make it the root folder. Any file you edit for your app should be in version control.

Whether or not to keep data in the repo is a judgment, in my opinion. I personally would if there's no pressing reason to keep it private, like data confidentiality, etc. Some may disagree. For a simple app, it seems fine.

If you do not think the data should be in version control, you can put the file in the .gitignore file in the root of your repo.


Erik
